channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Don Nelson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Don Nelson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Don Nelson
item.description:
During the 2009 NBA draft, he went against consensus and pushed Golden State to draft Stephen Curry with the No. 7 pick.

“One of the big reasons I was drafted by the Warriors was because of Don Nelson,”

Stephen Curry on Don Nelson, Aug 9, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Don Nelson
item.description:
“We then went to play Milwaukee... all of a sudden Don Nelson has labeled me the dirtiest player in the NBA, basically.”

Danny Ainge on Don Nelson, Apr 21, 2020. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Manute Bol on Don Nelson
item.description:
Bol told the LA Times in 1989.

“But (Nelson) said, 'If you think it's a good shot, take it.'”

Manute Bol on Don Nelson, May 16, 2019. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Rex Chapman on Don Nelson
item.description:
“He was still a little pudgy. I remember Cotton (Fitzsimmons) put him in an exhibition game and Steve got beat back-to-back times down the floor. Cotton looked at Danny (Ainge) and said, ‘Ah, the rook’s awful slow. I don’t know. I don’t know.’“But you could see how well he shot the ball, and he could get wherever he wanted to on the court. He got some tough love in Dallas from Nellie (Don Nelson), and made himself a pro. He was a worker, changed his diet and became as athletic as he possibly could. The efficiency with which he played, his use of his off-hand, his footwork, it was amazing.”

Rex Chapman on Don Nelson, Sep 10, 2018. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Stephen Jackson on Don Nelson, Baron Davis
item.description:
“We're in Utah and the drug test people are around, you know, to get our last drug test, so we can smoke, right? And Don Nelson, we talked about weed all the time, he was cool with talking about weed. We got our last test in Utah, right? So me and Baron [Davis] are coming out the locker room just screaming, excited, right, with our last pink slip saying we could smoke for the rest of the season. And Don Nelson hauls ass down there giving us high-fives like, 'Yeah, we can smoke now!' It was cool, the fact that he knows what's going on off the court with his players, which was great, man. We enjoyed it. And that's why we were a great team.”

Stephen Jackson on Don Nelson, Baron Davis, Jan 30, 2017. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Joe Lacob on Don Nelson, Peter Guber
item.description:
Joe Lacob:

“I fired Don Nelson before I even owned the team. I got in trouble for that. I got fined. They say, ‘You can’t fire (Don Nelson). You don’t own the team.’ I said, ‘No, I am. I’m firing him.’ I turned to Peter Guber & I said, 'They r terrible. We r terrible.' That was my 1st reaction (1st game). It was just an awful team.”

Joe Lacob on Don Nelson, Peter Guber, Dec 27, 2014. Source: Twitter @diamond83.

item.title: Anthony Tolliver on Don Nelson
item.description:
Nelson, however, had a strained relationship with Wolves forward Anthony Randolph in Golden State -- another concern he would have to allay.

“[Nelson is] a great coach and he def[initely] would be able to use all of the firepower we have,”

Anthony Tolliver on Don Nelson, Jul 14, 2011. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Joe Lacob on Don Nelson
item.description:
Marcus Thompson:New owner Joe Lacob on Don Nelson:

“I don’t care if it’s $6 million, he wasn’t the right guy to coach this team.”

Joe Lacob on Don Nelson, Nov 16, 2010. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Reggie Williams on Don Nelson
item.description:
“I came in under Nelson. I just don't know what to say. It hit me by surprise. I'm just so happy to be a part of (Nelson's all-time NBA wins record).”

Reggie Williams on Don Nelson, Sep 25, 2010. Source: San Jose Mercury-News.

item.title: Phil Jackson on Don Nelson
item.description:
Scott Howard-Cooper:Phil Jackson on Don Nelson being fired by Warriors:

“I'm not surprised. But yet I don't like the way Don had to go out.”

Phil Jackson on Don Nelson, Sep 24, 2010. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Don Nelson
item.description:
Curry has no inside knowledge as to what the Warriors front office has planned regarding the head coach position, but he is comfortable either way due to the forgoing of a strong relationship with Nelson last season.

“He (Nelson) has his own style. If you are not familiar with it, it's tough to describe and get thru that first year. For me, I definitely got along with him very well.”

Stephen Curry on Don Nelson, Aug 17, 2010. Source: HoopsWorld.
